meta.processName: Large commercial property underwriting and issuance
meta.disclosure: Illustrative. The structure comes from the source BPMN; timings, volumes and costs are assumptions.
meta.summary: Click any activity for business detail. All 5 cases scale the same representative route: clearance passes → in appetite → physical survey required → fac reinsurance required → within authority → broker binds → policy issued. Off-route branches (decline, referral-decline, submission-lost, negotiate loop) are drawn but not scheduled.

lanes.name: Commercial Property Underwriter

details.desc: Broker transmits a large-commercial property submission (SOV, loss runs, application, supplemental questionnaires).
details.note: Maps to BPMN Start_SubmissionReceived (message start event).

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: UA searches PAS and clearance system to prevent duplicate quoting, broker-of-record conflicts, and prior declinations.
pain: Manual keyword search misses variants of insured names
Broker BOR letters not always attached

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Exclusive gateway on clearance outcome.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Standard decline letter for clearance conflicts or out-of-appetite submissions.
details.note: Not on animated route. Also target of AppetiteNo path.

details.desc: Submission closed with decline/rejection notification.
UA cleans SOV inconsistencies (COPE gaps, TIV rounding, address normalization), geocodes locations, resolves occupancy codes.
pain: Location-level completeness varies wildly by broker
details.note: Maps to BPMN Task_ScrubSOVAndGeocode (service task, but performed with heavy manual QA).

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Line-of-business rules check: occupancy appetite, TIV bands, geography, aggregate capacity availability.
details.who: UW Assistant, supported by rules engine
details.note: Maps to BPMN Task_TriageAppetite (business rule task).

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Exclusive gateway on appetite outcome.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Routes submission to the appropriate commercial property UW by geography, industry, and TIV band.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: UW reviews submission holistically: COPE data, loss history, protections, occupancy, business continuity exposures.
pain: Fragmented data across SOV, application, loss runs, broker email thread

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Parallel gateway forking Risk Engineering desk review and CAT modeling ingestion.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Risk engineer reviews COPE narrative, sprinkler classifications, protective systems, prior loss patterns.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Engineer determines whether physical inspection is required based on TIV, occupancy, prior surveys, and loss history.
details.note: Maps to BPMN Gate_PhysicalSurveyNeeded. Representative route selects YES.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Field engineer visits site(s): construction verification, sprinkler test records, housekeeping, hot-work programs, business continuity walkthrough.
details.effort: ~5 business days elapsed (scheduling, travel, inspection, notes)
pain: Multi-location schedules extend elapsed time significantly
details.note: Maps to BPMN Task_PerformPhysicalSiteSurvey. Physical dependency that cannot be automated away.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

nodes.label: Publish Risk Report: PML, MFL & Recs

details.desc: Formal risk engineering report: Probable Maximum Loss, Maximum Foreseeable Loss, protection assessment, recommendations.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Analyst loads scrubbed SOV into RMS/AIR, maps occupancy/construction codes, resolves geocoding warnings.
details.note: Maps to BPMN Task_IngestSOVCATPlatform. BPMN types it service task, but requires manual mapping QA.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Executes CAT model runs, produces AAL, OEP/AEP curves at portfolio and account level, interprets uncertainty.
details.effort: ~2 business days including run queue + interpretation

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Join synchronizes RE and CAT results before UW can structure layering.
details.note: Maps to BPMN Join_Assessments. Waits on max(RE=5040, CAT=2880) → 5040.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Structures the placement: attachment, layers, participations, order of layers, quota share vs excess strategy.
details.note: Maps to BPMN Task_DetermineLayeringStructure. Also negotiate-loop return target.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Technical rate calc, schedule credits/debits, CAT loads, experience-rating credibility blending.
details.note: Maps to BPMN Task_TechnicalPricingExperienceRating (business rule task).

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Selects policy forms, endorsements, sublimits; drafts any manuscript wording deviations.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Determines if the desired gross line exceeds net retention and treaty capacity, requiring facultative placement.
details.note: Maps to BPMN Gate_ReinsuranceRequired. Representative route selects YES.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Ceded team drafts fac slip: exposure summary, PML, CAT metrics, layer being ceded, terms sought.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Presents slip to fac reinsurance market, negotiates terms, obtains signed lines and binder confirmation.
details.effort: ~4 business days elapsed (market shopping, quotes, sign-down)
details.note: Maps to BPMN Task_ObtainFacBinder. External counterparty wait that persists after AI adoption.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Compares proposed terms (limit, deductible structure, manuscript wording) against delegated UW authority.
details.note: Maps to BPMN Gate_AuthorityLimitExceeded. Representative route selects WITHIN AUTHORITY.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Technical UW authority reviews out-of-authority items and signs off, modifies, or declines.
details.note: Off animated route (representative case is within authority). Preserved as available control.

details.desc: Approved / endorsed → quote; declined → risk exit.
Terminal: declined by authority.
Compiles quote proposal: primary, excess layer, quota-share alternatives; premium options; conditions.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Formal quote proposal transmitted to broker with subjectivities list.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Gateway includes broker decision wait time (illustrative ~3–4 business days for large commercial).
details.note: Maps to BPMN Gate_BrokerDecision. Representative route selects BIND.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Terminal: declined or expired.
UW receives bind order, reconciles against issued quote, notes any last-minute changes.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Reviews all pre-bind subjectivities cleared (COPE updates, financials, sanctions/OFAC screening).

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Executes legally binding binder confirmation to broker.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Assembles the final policy package: dec sheet, schedule of forms, manuscript endorsements.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Independent QA on all policy fields; ceded reinsurance allocation verified against fac binder and treaty.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Books premium and commission in PAS, triggers GL accounting entries.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Transmits executed policy contract to broker.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.

details.desc: Policy in force. Ongoing servicing begins.

provenance.note: Structure from the source BPMN. Timings are estimates.
